# secureaccess_roaming_computer (Data Source)

This data source reads the Roaming Computer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_roaming_computer" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `name` (String) The name of the Roaming Computer. Used to find the Roaming Computer on create, a later change renames it.

### Read-Only

- `anyconnect_device_id` (String) The ID of the device that has the Cisco Secure Client deployed with the Internet Security module.
- `applied_bundle` (Number) The ID of the policy applied to the Roaming Computer.
- `delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) When `true`, the Roaming Computer is removed from Secure Access on destroy. When `false`, it is only removed from the Terraform state.
- `device_id` (String) The hex ID of the Roaming Computer.
- `has_ip_blocking` (Boolean) Specifies whether the Roaming Computer has IP blocking.
- `origin_id` (Number) The origin ID of the Roaming Computer.
- `os_version` (String) The OS version of the Roaming Computer.
- `os_version_name` (String) The OS version name of the Roaming Computer.
- `secure_client_version` (String) The version of the Roaming Computer client.
- `secure_web_gateway_status` (String) The status of the Roaming Computer with Internet security (Secure Web Gateway).
- `status` (String) The status of the Roaming Computer with DNS-layer security.
- `type` (String) The type of the Roaming Computer.
